invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of add(...), which should not be null.
A new Label is created and added, so result should contain a Label.
skin.getFont(fontName) is called, which may throw if fontName is null.
skin.getColor(colorName) is called, which may throw if colorName is null.
Even if text is null, a Label is constructed and added, so the actor in result should still exist.
